game_title: Fallback: Shelf Sorter – Fallen Statue Garden
game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the relic hunter must hold off cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Shelf Sorter: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of spirit candles from smallest to largest.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of spirit candles from smallest to largest. Then check order_score and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obelisk from cursed statues in Fallen Statue Garden: keep order_score above zero until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Shelf Sorter
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 6, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
